caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object rendered in shades of black, gray, and white. The object is composed of two parallel vertical bars rising from a horizontal, slightly curved base. Each vertical bar ends at the top in a simple outward curl or hook. The bottom ends of the bars flatten and extend outward horizontally, each with a series of equally spaced rivet holes. The middle section connecting the two bars is a wide, flat plate that curves gently upwards in the center, joining the vertical bars approximately midway up their length. The lines and shading give the object a textured, metallic appearance. The drawing is presented on an off-white or light beige background, bordered by a thin black line forming a rectangular frame. In the lower left corner, the name "HOLGER HANSEN" is printed in capital letters.
title: Foot Scraper
